exercises.instruction: Match the sentences on the left with the sentences on the right.
items: 1 I feel sick.
2 I'm fine.
3 I've got toothache.
4 I feel really ill.
5 I don't feel very well.
a I'm going to ring the dentist.
b I think I should call a doctor.
c I think I'll go home and rest.
d I think I ate something bad.
e I feel very well.

exercises.instruction: Say the words aloud, then write them down.
items: Example: /'dɒktə/ doctor
1 /'hedeɪk/
2 /mə'leəriə/
3 /'æsmə/
4 /'kænsə/
5 /'kɒlərə/
